verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a localhost API bundled with the desktop app and a CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation. It also has an official MCP server for AI assistants and an agents skill that lets assistants "read, search, and modify Objects", backed by a published, versioned OpenAPI spec. That covers both read and write without touching the GUI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent read/write works headlessly in practice.
